Video Converter MOV — Initial Release

- Launches MOV to MP4 video conversion with a cloud-based backend, supporting MOV, MP4, AVI, and WebM uploads up to 500MB.
- Automatically handles session setup, token management, and user onboarding.
- Provides fast, high-quality format conversion ideal for sharing iPhone/Mac videos cross-platform.
- Exposes key features like exporting, uploading, credits, and state checks via simple text prompts.
- Includes robust error handling and clear guidance for common workflows and edge cases.
